description: DS-to-DS federation endpoint: submit an MLS commit for sequencing. Only the sequencer DS for a conversation accepts commits.

main.description: Accept a commit for CAS (compare-and-swap) epoch ordering. The receiving DS must be the sequencer for the conversation. The calling DS must be a participant in the group. Uses optimistic concurrency: if the proposed epoch conflicts with the current epoch, a CommitConflict error is returned.

senderDsDid.description: DID of the sending delivery service (must match JWT issuer)

epoch.description: Current MLS epoch the commit is based on

proposedEpoch.description: Proposed new MLS epoch after the commit is applied

accepted.description: Whether the commit was accepted and sequenced

assignedEpoch.description: The epoch number assigned by the sequencer

receipt.description: Optional sequencer receipt or proof of ordering

errors.name: NotSequencer
errors.description: This DS is not the sequencer for the specified conversation

errors.name: CommitConflict
errors.description: The proposed epoch conflicts with the current epoch (CAS failure). The client should fetch the latest epoch and retry.

errors.name: AuthFailed
errors.description: JWT validation failed, senderDsDid does not match JWT issuer, or the calling DS is not a participant in the conversation
